THE WORLD’S BESTSELLING HERO RETURNS

Buckle up for the thrilling new adventure that sees Jack Reacher called in to investigate the brutal murder of a covert operative, uncovering a dangerous conspiracy where no one can be trusted…

'The latest Jack Reacher adventure is the best in a decade.' THE TIMES

‘A piece of pure thriller-writing gold.' LISA JEWELL, bestselling author of It Could Have Been Her

'Reacher is back!!!! ... this one was a classic.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Reader review

'The latest Jack Reacher book, #31 in the series, is the best so far.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Reader review

Jack Reacher is a hard man to track down. And that’s just the way he likes it.

But General Susan Turner, based deep inside the Pentagon, has the means, and the motive, to do so.
She needs his help. A member of her team has been brutally murdered on covert duty. She can’t trust anyone she works with, not even her deputy. She needs someone from the outside. Someone who solves problems and disappears without a trace.

Reacher heads to Summertown, Colorado. A town as remote and bizarre as it gets. One diner, one motel, five massive data centres, two giant solar farms humming away in the dust. Total population: four people. And one of them is watching him.

But Reacher isn’t built to run. He’s built to finish things.

General Turner knows: if they come for him, they'll regret it - all the way to the top of the chain.

EARLY READERS ARE LOVING CHAIN REACTION:

‘Everything I love about Jack Reacher. Taut, tense, unputdownable.' LAURA SHEPHERD-ROBINSON, bestselling author of The Square of Sevens

'It's a straight shot. Reacher again shoots the light out of all competitors.' PETER JAMES, the UK no.1 bestselling author of Picture You Dead

'An addictive read! Thirty-one novels in, and there's no stopping Reacher.' MICK HERRON, bestselling author of Slow Horses

'Times change. Technology evolves. But Reacher stays Reacher... it’s absolutely worth your time.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

'Fun fact: you can ABSOLUTELY start reading a book series at the 31st instalment.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

'I devoured this in a day and a half. Will I read more from the author(s)? Hell, yes.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

'The team of Lee and Andrew Child have a winner on their hands.' ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

PRAISE FOR JACK REACHER:

'The coolest continuing series character' STEPHEN KING

'These books are absolutely addictive' DAILY MIRROR

'Everyone's favourite rebel hero' KARIN SLAUGHTER
